clause: Layout style types in StudioStyleRegistry + application mechanics [STU-LAY-036,STU-LAY-037]

scope.summary: Register the layout style types as records in the shared StudioStyleRegistry (never a forked style store): Paragraph style (full paragraph-level bundle; attribute payload owned by 14.7; layout-flow attrs per MT-155), Character style (partial-attribute run-level, applies only explicitly set attributes), Object style (frame/object formatting with per-category include toggles — stroke, fill, effects, text-frame options, text wrap, anchoring, fitting, export options, size/position — plus default text-frame and graphic-frame style slots), Table style (references up to five cell styles: header/footer/body/left-column/right-column, plus border and alternating patterns), Cell style (insets, strokes, fills, diagonal lines, optional paragraph style), TOC style (stored TOC definitions per MT-173, reusable across documents/books). Implement application mechanics across all types: based-on inheritance (child stores only deltas, updates on parent change), next-style chaining for paragraph styles (apply-then-next formatting a whole selection sequentially), override handling (override indicator, highlighter, clear-overrides with char-vs-paragraph scoping, clear-on-apply toggle), redefine-style from selection, break-link-to-style (freeze current formatting as local values), and style groups (folders participating in load/import). Optional bundled style sets and role-detecting auto-style application MAY layer over this.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-LAY-036]** Every named format is a record in the shared `StudioStyleRegistry`.

**[STU-LAY-037]** Style application mechanics MUST be preserved across all style types: based-on inheritance where a child stores only deltas; next-style chaining for paragraph styles; override handling with an override indicator, an override highlighter, clear-overrides with character-versus- paragraph scoping and a clear-on-apply toggle; redefine-style from the current selection; break-link to freeze current formatting as local values; and style groups.

**[STU-LAY-067]** Every capability in this catalog MUST be exposed through BOTH the operator UI and the typed model-steerable command/MCP surface as two projections of one primitive per [STU-DOC-004], MUST satisfy the model-visibility/steerability and parallel-workflow requirements (14.16, 14.17), MUST obey the headless/quiet output law so preflight, package, print, PDF and merge never steal focus or block on a foreground window (14.20), and MUST be represented in the dual-audience UserManual and the GUI/diagnostic and accessibility surfaces (14.22, 14.16). Model-authored layout mutations MUST pass the sandbox -> validation -> `PromotionGate` lifecycle ([STU-ARC-005]) via the propose-work system (14.18) before layout authority rows change. All durable layout authority persists through the canonical Studio SurrealDB tables and `studio.layout` EventLedger events (14.23) under the SurrealDB-only authority guard ([STU-SDB-002]); live collaborative editing is CRDT-backed. This obligation is stated once and is not restated per clause.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.

Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.
